name: surrealdb-local
description: Connect Codex to a local or self-hosted SurrealDB instance through its built-in MCP route

interface.shortDescription: Connect to a SurrealDB instance you run
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex directly to the built-in MCP HTTP route of a local, self-hosted, private-network, or air-gapped SurrealDB instance. The plugin includes Codex-specific setup, authentication, routing, troubleshooting, and safety guidance.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my local SurrealDB instance
